items.title: Vessel Browser – An open-source browser built for AI agents, not humans
items.raw_excerpt: I'm Tyler - the solo operator of Quanta Intellect based in Portland, Oregon. I recently participated in Nous Research's Hermes Agent Hackathon, which is where this project was born.
